segments.source: Khale lialikho litaala elala eliabandu bali nibamwenya mubusangafu.
Bakhonyanga abebusi babu hango nende mumukunda.
Ne shibafuchirirungwa okhusuta hambi no muliro tawe.
Ne mulala khu basiani yekomba okhutsia okhwora omubasu.
Inyanga ndala, yekomba muno muno okhukhola ario.
Abaana be iula baberera muno muno, olwabalola owashiabwe nasalulukha muliuba.
Nibalonga liyoni okhurula khu iula yali niyisalulushe.
Nibabukula omusiani wabu weliyoni, nibamuira khu shikulu eshirambi.
Ne olwa elimba liarula, napurukha hekulu niyemba mubulafu bwe itsuli.
